questions.answer: Because the heart needs **divine calm** before it can choose correctly.
questions.explanation: Mercy stabilizes the soul.

questions.question: What does '**rashad**' teach about ease?
questions.answer: That true ease includes **correct direction**, not just escape.
questions.explanation: Guidance prevents future hardship.

questions.question: What mindset does this dua build?
questions.answer: **Courage with reliance**.
questions.explanation: It blends effort and trust.

title: 🌿 Rabbi Ishrah Li Sadri – Expansion & Facilitation
intro: The dua of Musa (AS), seeking inner expansion, clarity, and ease before facing a daunting mission.
arabicFull: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
transliterationFull: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wahlul ‘uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli.
translationFull: My Lord, expand my chest for me, make my task easy for me, and untie the knot from my tongue so they may understand my speech.
story: Before confronting Pharaoh, Musa (AS) asked not for dominance — but for **inner expansion**, **ease in responsibility**, and clarity in speech. He understood that outer victory begins with **inner steadiness**.
benefits: 🫀 Seeks **emotional expansion** before facing challenges.
🛤 Requests Allah to **facilitate difficult tasks**.
🗣 Builds clarity and confidence.
✨ Teaches that strength flows from faith.

phrases.meaning: My Lord, expand my chest for me
make my task easy for me,

questions.question: How does this dua change fear?
questions.answer: It replaces fear with **divine support**.
questions.explanation: Reliance builds courage.

title: 🌿 Allahumma La Sahla – Surrendering Ease to Allah
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
intro: A profound declaration of surrender, affirming that nothing becomes easy except by Allah’s will.
transliterationFull: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja‘altahu sahlan wa anta taj‘alul hazna idha shi’ta sahlan.
translationFull: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy, and You make difficulty easy if You will.
story: This supplication is pure **surrender**. It acknowledges that ease does not come from intelligence, strength, or planning — but from Allah alone. What feels heavy can become light instantly by His will.
benefits: 🕊 Builds **complete reliance**.
🤍 Reduces anxiety through surrender.
🌅 Reinforces belief in divine power.
✨ Anchors the heart in humility.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا

phrases.meaning: O Allah, there is no ease except what You make easy,

phrases.transliteration: Wa anta taj‘alul hazna idha shi’ta sahlan
phrases.meaning: and You make difficulty easy if You will.

questions.question: What does this dua teach about control?

questions.explanation: Human effort is secondary.

questions.answer: It removes the burden of false control.
questions.explanation: Trust lightens the heart.

questions.explanation: It anchors success in divine will.

title: 🌿 La Ilaha Illallah Al-Halim Al-Karim – Words of Relief
intro: Words the Prophet ﷺ recited in distress — anchoring the heart in Tawheed, divine greatness, and hope.
arabicFull: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliterationFull: La ilaha illallahul-Halimul-Karim, la ilaha illallahul-‘Aliyyul-‘Azim, la ilaha illallah Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-‘Arshil-‘Azim.
translationFull: There is no deity except Allah, the Most Forbearing, the Most Generous. There is no deity except Allah, the Most High, the Most Great. There is no deity except Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
story:
The Prophet ﷺ would recite these words during **intense distress**.

Notice — he did not begin with requests. He began with **Tawheed**.

Repeating 'La ilaha illa Allah' three times anchors the heart in one truth: **ultimate control belongs to Allah alone**.

By mentioning **Al-Halim (The Forbearing)** and **Al-Karim (The Generous)**, the heart remembers that Allah is patient with our weakness and generous in relief.

When Allah’s greatness fills the heart, fear begins to shrink.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Ahsin ‘Aqibatana – A Beautiful End in All Affairs
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسِنْ عَاقِبَتَنَا فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا وَأَجِرْنَا مِنْ خِزْيِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ
intro: A comprehensive dua asking not just for relief, but for a beautiful ending in all affairs and protection in both worlds.
transliterationFull: Allahumma ahsin ‘aqibatana fil-umuri kulliha wa ajirna min khizyid-dunya wa ‘adhabil-akhirah.
translationFull: O Allah, grant us a good end in all of our affairs and protect us from humiliation in this world and punishment in the Hereafter.
story:
This supplication shifts focus from temporary comfort to **ultimate outcomes**.

Instead of asking only for immediate ease, it asks for a **beautiful conclusion** to every matter.

Some hardships may remain — but what matters most is how they end.

True ease is not just comfort today — it is being saved from **worldly humiliation** and **eternal punishment**.

It is a dua of long vision — of someone who measures life by the **akhirah**.
benefits: 🌅 Builds perspective beyond short-term relief.
🤍 Aligns priorities with the **Hereafter**.
🛡 Seeks protection from humiliation in this life and loss in the next.
✨ Encourages decisions guided by eternal success.

title: 🌿 Rabbi Inni Lima Anzalta – A Dua of Complete Need
arabicFull: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
transliterationFull: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
translationFull: My Lord, I am truly in need of whatever good You send down to me.
intro: A powerful dua of humility and reliance upon Allah when seeking goodness, provision, and guidance in life decisions.
story:
This dua was made by Prophet Musa (AS) after he fled from Egypt and arrived in Madyan. He had no food, shelter, or support. After helping two women water their flock, he turned to Allah with this simple yet profound dua.

According to Tafsir Ibn Kathir, Musa (AS) was extremely hungry and exhausted. Despite helping others while in hardship, he did not ask people for anything. Instead, he asked Allah alone.

Soon after making this dua, one of the women returned and invited him to her father. That father was the righteous man Shu'ayb (AS), who gave Musa food, safety, and eventually marriage and work.

This moment shows how a sincere call to Allah during hardship can open doors of provision, guidance, and life-changing opportunities.

🌿 Encourages humility in times of need

title: 🌿 Allahumma Inni Astakhiruka – The Dua of Istikhara
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi 'ilmika wa astaqdiruka bi qudratika wa as'aluka min fadlika al-'azim. Fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha al-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fihi. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadha al-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anhu waqdur li al-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bihi.
translationFull: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge and seek ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your immense bounty. For You have power while I have none, and You know while I do not know, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. But if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me the good wherever it may be, and make me content with it.
intro: The famous dua of Istikhara taught by the Prophet ﷺ for seeking Allah’s guidance before making important decisions.
story:
According to the hadith narrated by Jabir ibn Abdullah in Sahih al-Bukhari, the Prophet ﷺ used to teach his companions the dua of Istikhara just as carefully as he taught them a surah from the Qur'an. When a companion faced an important decision, the Prophet ﷺ instructed them to pray two voluntary rak‘ahs and then make this dua.

Istikhara literally means 'to seek the best choice.' Instead of relying solely on personal judgment, a believer turns to Allah, acknowledging that human knowledge is limited while Allah’s knowledge encompasses everything.

This dua beautifully expresses humility: the servant admits weakness ('You have power and I do not') and limited understanding ('You know and I do not'). Then the believer asks Allah to guide the outcome — either by facilitating the matter if it is good, or removing it if it is harmful.

🤲 Strengthens reliance upon Allah
🧠 Reminds us of the limits of human knowledge
✨ Helps bring peace and contentment with outcomes
🌿 Encourages thoughtful decision-making through prayer

title: 🌿 Allahumma Inni As'aluka Min Al-Khayri Kullihi – Asking Allah for All Good
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ قَضَيْتَهُ لِي خَيْرًا
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni as'aluka min al-khayri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam. Wa a'udhu bika min ash-sharri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam. Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'adha bihi 'abduka wa nabiyyuka. Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannah wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amal, wa a'udhu bika min an-nar wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amal. Wa as'aluka an taj'ala kulla qada'in qadaytahu li khayran.
translationFull: O Allah, I ask You for all good — immediate and future — what I know of it and what I do not know. And I seek refuge in You from all evil — immediate and future — what I know of it and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings one closer to it in speech or action, and I seek refuge in You from the Fire and whatever brings one closer to it in speech or action. And I ask You to make every decree You decree for me good.
intro: A comprehensive dua taught by the Prophet ﷺ asking Allah for every form of good and protection from every form of evil.
story:
This powerful supplication was narrated by Aisha (RA). She reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught this dua as a comprehensive prayer that gathers together all goodness and protection from all evil. Instead of asking for only specific things, the believer asks Allah for every good — known and unknown — and seeks refuge from every evil — known and unknown.

This dua reflects the deep understanding that humans cannot foresee everything that benefits or harms them. By asking Allah for all good and protection from all evil, the believer entrusts every aspect of life to Allah’s wisdom.

The supplication also connects the believer to the prayers of the Prophet ﷺ by asking Allah for the same good that the Prophet asked for and protection from the same evil he sought refuge from.

🛡️ Seeks protection from all forms of evil
🤲 Aligns our supplication with the duas of the Prophet ﷺ
🧭 Encourages reliance upon Allah’s wisdom

title: 🌿 Allahumma Astahdika Li Arshadi Amri – Seeking Right Guidance

intro: A short supplication asking Allah for the most correct guidance in one's affairs and protection from the evil of the self.
story:
This concise dua reflects a believer’s dependence on Allah for guidance. A person acknowledges that true direction comes only from Allah and asks to be guided to the most upright and correct decision. At the same time, the supplicant seeks protection from the harmful inclinations of the self (nafs), recognizing that inner desires and impulses can lead a person away from what is best.

Such supplications were often made by the Prophet ﷺ when seeking guidance in matters, emphasizing humility and reliance on Allah’s wisdom.

title: 🌿 Allahumma Inni As'aluka Min Al-Khayri Kullihi – Seeking the Best Outcome
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَاذَ مِنْهُ عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَا قَرَّبَ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ عَمَلٍ وَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كُلَّ قَضَاءٍ تَقْضِيهِ لِي خَيْرًا
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni as'aluka min al-khayri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam. Allahumma inni as'aluka min khayri ma sa'alaka 'abduka wa nabiyyuka Muhammad ﷺ wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma 'adha minhu 'abduka wa nabiyyuka. Allahumma inni as'aluka al-jannah wa ma qarraba ilayha min qawlin aw 'amal wa as'aluka an taj'ala kulla qada'in taqdihi li khayran.
translationFull: O Allah, I ask You for all good — immediate and future — what I know of it and what I do not know. O Allah, I ask You for the good that Your servant and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ asked You for, and I seek refuge in You from the evil from which Your servant and Prophet sought refuge. O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and whatever brings one closer to it in speech or action, and I ask You to make every decree You decree for me good.
intro: A comprehensive supplication asking Allah for all goodness and that every decree He makes becomes good for the believer.
story:
This powerful dua was narrated by Aisha (RA), who reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught her this supplication as a comprehensive prayer. It gathers together the request for every type of good and protection from every type of harm.

The believer asks Allah for all forms of goodness — both immediate and future — whether known or unknown. Then the supplicant aligns their prayer with the supplications of the Prophet ﷺ by asking for the same good he asked for and seeking refuge from the same evil he sought protection from.

The dua concludes with a profound request: that whatever Allah decrees for the believer ultimately becomes good.
benefits: 🌿 A comprehensive dua asking for all good
🛡️ Seeks protection from all forms of evil
🤲 Connects the believer's supplication to the duas of the Prophet ﷺ
🧭 Encourages complete trust in Allah’s decree
✨ Reminds us that true success lies in Allah’s guidance

title: Rabbana Atina Fid-Dunya Hasanah – Good in This Life and the Hereafter
arabicFull: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

intro: One of the most comprehensive Qur’anic supplications asking for goodness in both this life and the next.
story:
This beautiful dua appears in Surah Al-Baqarah and follows the verse describing people who ask only for worldly gains. Allah then praises those who ask for both worldly goodness and eternal success.

The Prophet ﷺ frequently recited this supplication, making it one of the most beloved and comprehensive duas in Islam. It balances the needs of this life with the ultimate goal of the Hereafter.

The dua teaches believers to seek blessings in their worldly life — such as health, knowledge, family, and provision — while also striving for the greater success of the Hereafter.

arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي

translationFull: O Allah, I ask You for wellbeing in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and wellbeing in my religion, my worldly life, my family, and my wealth.
intro: A comprehensive supplication taught by the Prophet ﷺ asking Allah for forgiveness and wellbeing in all aspects of life.
story:
This supplication was narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar (RA). The Prophet ﷺ would often make this dua in the morning and evening, asking Allah for forgiveness ('afw) and wellbeing ('afiyah).

The dua emphasizes that true wellbeing includes protection of faith, stability in worldly life, safety for family, and protection of one's wealth. Scholars explain that 'afiyah includes health, safety, protection from calamities, and freedom from hardship.

The Prophet ﷺ taught that asking Allah for 'afiyah is among the best supplications a believer can make.

title: Allahumma Aslih Li Deeni – Rectifying Religion, Life, and Hereafter
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
transliterationFull: Allahumma aslih li deeni alladhi huwa 'ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyaya allati fiha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhirati allati fiha ma'adi. Waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr.
translationFull: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs. Set right for me my worldly life wherein is my livelihood. Set right for me my Hereafter to which is my return. Make life for me an increase in every good, and make death for me a relief from every evil.
intro: A comprehensive supplication asking Allah to rectify one's religion, worldly life, and the Hereafter.
story:
This powerful supplication was narrated by Abu Hurairah (RA) and recorded in Sahih Muslim. The Prophet ﷺ would teach believers to ask Allah to correct the three essential dimensions of life: religion, worldly affairs, and the Hereafter.

The dua begins with the religion (deen), because faith is the foundation that protects a person's life and actions. It then asks for the wellbeing of worldly life where one's livelihood exists, followed by the Hereafter which is the ultimate destination.

The supplication ends with a profound request: that life becomes a means of increasing good deeds and that death becomes relief from evil and hardship.

🌍 Asks for wellbeing in worldly life
🌙 Focuses on success in the Hereafter

🤲 Teaches reliance on Allah in all aspects of life

title: Allahumma Inni As'aluka Al-'Afiyah – Protection and Wellbeing
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
transliterationFull: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'aluka al-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahumma ustur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati. Allahumma ihfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi 'azamatika an ughtala min tahti.
translationFull: O Allah, I ask You for wellbeing in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and wellbeing in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me; and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being attacked from beneath me.
intro: A powerful prophetic supplication asking Allah for wellbeing, forgiveness, protection, and safety from all directions.
story:
This supplication was narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar (RA), who reported that the Prophet ﷺ never left these words in the morning and evening.

The dua begins by asking Allah for 'afiyah — a comprehensive word that includes safety, health, protection, and wellbeing in both worldly life and the Hereafter.

It then asks Allah to conceal one's faults and remove fear and anxiety. Finally, the supplication asks for protection from every direction, symbolizing complete reliance upon Allah's protection.

title: Rabbana Ighfir Lana Wa Li Ikhwanina – Forgiveness for All Believers
arabicFull: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
transliterationFull: Rabbana ighfir lana wa li ikhwanina alladhina sabaquna bil-iman wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu rabbana innaka ra'ufur-rahim
translationFull: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts any resentment toward those who believe. Our Lord, indeed You are Most Kind and Most Merciful.
intro: A Qur’anic supplication asking Allah for forgiveness for ourselves and earlier believers and to purify our hearts from resentment.
story: This verse appears in Surah Al-Hashr describing righteous believers who came after the companions. According to Tafsir Ibn Kathir, they pray for the earlier believers and ask Allah to remove any hatred or resentment from their hearts. The verse emphasizes unity, purity of heart, and love among believers.
benefits: 🤲 Seeks forgiveness for oneself and other believers
❤️ Asks Allah to purify the heart from resentment
📖 A Qur’anic dua promoting unity among Muslims

phrases.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ

phrases.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in our hearts resentment toward believers. Our Lord, You are Most Kind and Most Merciful

questions.question: Who does this dua ask forgiveness for?
questions.answer: Ourselves and our brothers who preceded us in faith.
questions.explanation: It promotes unity by including earlier believers.

questions.question: What does 'ghill' mean and why ask to remove it?
questions.answer: Resentment or hatred. Pure hearts have no ill will toward believers.
questions.explanation: The verse emphasizes love and purity among the ummah.

questions.question: In which Surah is this supplication found?
questions.answer: Surah Al-Hashr (59:10).
questions.explanation: It describes the prayer of righteous believers who came after the companions.

According to Tafsir Ibn Kathir, they pray for the earlier believers and ask Allah to remove any hatred or resentment from their hearts. The verse emphasizes unity, purity of heart, and love among believers.
benefits: 🤲 Seeks forgiveness for oneself and other believers
❤️ Asks Allah to purify the heart from resentment
📖 A Qur’anic dua promoting unity among Muslims

phrases.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ
phrases.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir lana wa li ikhwanina alladhina sabaquna bil-iman
phrases.meaning: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith

phrases.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
phrases.transliteration: Wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu rabbana innaka ra'ufur-rahim
phrases.meaning: Do not place resentment in our hearts toward believers. Our Lord, You are Most Kind and Most Merciful

questions.question: Who are the 'brothers who preceded us in faith'?
questions.answer: Earlier believers, including the companions and those before them.
questions.explanation: The dua asks forgiveness for the whole ummah.

questions.question: What two names of Allah close this dua?
questions.answer: Ar-Ra'uf (Most Kind) and Ar-Rahim (Most Merciful).
questions.explanation: They affirm hope in Allah's mercy and kindness.

questions.question: Why is removing resentment (ghill) from the heart important?
questions.answer: So that love and unity among believers remain strong.
questions.explanation: Purity of heart is essential for brotherhood in faith.

title: Sayyidul Istighfar – The Master Supplication for Forgiveness
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
transliterationFull: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu. A'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa abu'u laka bidhambi. Faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunuba illa anta.
translationFull: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I uphold Your covenant and promise as best as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sins, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
intro: The greatest supplication for seeking forgiveness, taught by the Prophet ﷺ.
story: The Prophet ﷺ described this supplication as Sayyidul Istighfar (the master of seeking forgiveness). According to the hadith recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari, whoever recites it during the day with firm faith and dies that day will enter Paradise, and whoever recites it at night with firm faith and dies before morning will enter Paradise.
benefits: 🤲 The greatest supplication for forgiveness
🌿 Acknowledges Allah’s blessings and our sins
✨ Promised reward of Paradise when recited with sincerity

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu
phrases.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I uphold Your covenant as best as I can

phrases.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي
phrases.transliteration: A'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa abu'u laka bidhambi
phrases.meaning: I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sins

phrases.arabic: فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
phrases.transliteration: Faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunuba illa anta
phrases.meaning: So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You

questions.question: What is Sayyidul Istighfar?
questions.answer: The master or greatest supplication for seeking forgiveness.
questions.explanation: The Prophet ﷺ described it as the best way to ask Allah for forgiveness.

questions.question: What must we acknowledge before asking for forgiveness in this dua?
questions.answer: Allah's blessings upon us and our own sins.
questions.explanation: True istighfar includes gratitude and accountability.

questions.question: What did the Prophet ﷺ promise for one who recites this with firm faith?
questions.answer: Whoever recites it by day with firm faith and dies that day, or by night and dies before morning, will enter Paradise.
questions.explanation: It shows the immense value of this supplication when said with sincerity.

title: Alhamdulillah Alladhi 'Afani – Gratitude for Life and Health
arabicFull: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
transliterationFull: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi wa radda 'alayya ruhi wa adhina li bidhikrih
translationFull: All praise is for Allah who has given me wellbeing in my body, returned my soul to me, and allowed me to remember Him.
intro: A beautiful supplication of gratitude recited upon waking up, thanking Allah for health and life.
story: The Prophet ﷺ taught this supplication to be recited upon waking from sleep. According to the hadith reported by Abu Hurairah (RA) in Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi, it reminds believers to begin the day with gratitude to Allah for restoring life after sleep, granting health, and giving the opportunity to remember Him.
benefits: 🌅 Encourages gratitude upon waking
💪 Acknowledges the blessing of health
🤲 Reminds believers that life itself is a gift from Allah

phrases.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي
phrases.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani fi jasadi wa radda 'alayya ruhi
phrases.meaning: All praise is for Allah who granted me wellbeing in my body and returned my soul to me
And allowed me to remember Him

questions.question: When is this dua recited?
questions.answer: Upon waking up from sleep.
questions.explanation: It begins the day with gratitude for life and health.

questions.question: What three things does it thank Allah for?
questions.answer: Wellbeing in the body, return of the soul, and the ability to remember Him.
questions.explanation: Sleep is like a small death; waking is a renewal of blessings.

questions.question: Who reported this supplication from the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.answer: Abu Hurairah (RA).
questions.explanation: It is found in Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi.

outsideSalah: At the beginning of the day

title: Alhamdu Lillahil-Ladhi Kafana – Gratitude for Provision
arabicFull: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي كَفَانَا وَأَرْوَانَا غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مَكْفُورٍ
transliterationFull: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kafana wa arwana ghayra makfiyyin wa la makfur
translationFull: All praise is for Allah who has sufficed us and given us drink, while He Himself is neither in need nor unappreciated.
intro: A supplication of gratitude said after eating or drinking, thanking Allah for providing sustenance.
story: Anas ibn Malik (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ would praise Allah after food and drink with these words. The dua reminds believers that all provision ultimately comes from Allah, and that He alone suffices His servants while never being in need of anyone.
benefits: 🤲 Expresses gratitude for food and drink
🌿 Reminds believers that Allah is the true provider
📖 A prophetic supplication after eating or drinking

phrases.meaning: All praise is for Allah who has sufficed us and given us drink
While He Himself is neither in need nor unappreciated

questions.question: When is this gratitude dua said?
questions.answer: After eating or drinking.
questions.explanation: It thanks Allah for provision and sustenance.

questions.question: What does 'ghayra makfiyyin wa la makfur' mean?
questions.answer: Allah is neither in need nor unappreciated.
questions.explanation: He gives without needing anything in return.

questions.question: Who reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this after food and drink?
questions.answer: Anas ibn Malik (RA).
questions.explanation: It is recorded in Sahih Muslim.

title: Alhamdu Lillahi Alladhi Kafani – Gratitude for Allah’s Blessings
arabicFull: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي كَفَانِي وَآوَانِي وَأَطْعَمَنِي وَسَقَانِي، وَالَّذِي مَنَّ عَلَيَّ فَأَفْضَلَ، وَالَّذِي أَعْطَانِي فَأَجْزَلَ، اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ، اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَالِكَهُ، وَإِلٰهَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
transliterationFull: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kafani wa awani wa at'amani wa saqani, walladhi manna 'alayya fa afdhal, walladhi a'tani fa ajzal. Alhamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal. Allahumma rabba kulli shay'in wa malikahu wa ilaha kulli shay', a'udhu bika min an-nar.
translationFull: All praise is for Allah who has sufficed me, sheltered me, fed me, and given me drink; who has favored me and given generously. All praise is for Allah in every circumstance. O Allah, Lord of everything and Owner of everything and the God of everything, I seek refuge in You from the Fire.
intro: A comprehensive supplication praising Allah for His blessings and seeking protection from the Fire.
story: This supplication expresses gratitude for Allah’s countless blessings such as shelter, food, drink, and generosity. The dua reminds believers to praise Allah in every circumstance and to recognize that all provision ultimately comes from Him. It concludes by seeking refuge from the Fire, emphasizing that true success lies in salvation in the Hereafter.
benefits: 🤲 Expresses gratitude for Allah’s blessings
🌿 Encourages praising Allah in all situations
🛡️ Seeks protection from the Fire

phrases.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي كَفَانِي وَآوَانِي وَأَطْعَمَنِي وَسَقَانِي، وَالَّذِي مَنَّ عَلَيَّ فَأَفْضَلَ، وَالَّذِي أَعْطَانِي فَأَجْزَلَ
phrases.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kafani wa awani wa at'amani wa saqani, walladhi manna 'alayya fa afdhal, walladhi a'tani fa ajzal
phrases.meaning: All praise is for Allah who has sufficed me, sheltered me, fed me, and given me drink, who has favored me and given generously
All praise is for Allah in every circumstance

phrases.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَالِكَهُ وَإِلٰهَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma rabba kulli shay'in wa malikahu wa ilaha kulli shay', a'udhu bika min an-nar
phrases.meaning: O Allah, Lord and Owner of everything and God of everything, I seek refuge in You from the Fire

questions.question: What blessings does this dua praise Allah for?
questions.answer: Being sufficed, sheltered, fed, and given drink; and Allah's favor and generosity.
questions.explanation: It is a comprehensive thanksgiving for daily blessings.

questions.question: What does 'Alhamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal' mean?
questions.answer: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
questions.explanation: We praise Allah in ease and in difficulty.

questions.question: How does the dua end?
questions.answer: By seeking refuge in Allah from the Fire.
questions.explanation: Gratitude and seeking salvation go together.

title: Alhamdu Lillahil-Ladhi Ahyana – Gratitude After Waking
arabicFull: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
transliterationFull: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
translationFull: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
intro: A supplication of gratitude recited upon waking up from sleep.
story: Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (RA) reported that when the Prophet ﷺ woke up from sleep he would say this dua. The supplication reminds believers that sleep resembles a temporary death and waking is like being given life again. It also reminds us that the final return and resurrection will be to Allah.
benefits: 🌅 Encourages gratitude when waking up
🤲 Reminds believers that life is a blessing from Allah
🌙 Reflects on resurrection and the return to Allah

phrases.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا
phrases.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana
phrases.meaning: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die
And to Him is the resurrection

questions.question: What does this dua compare sleep and waking to?
questions.answer: Sleep is like being caused to die; waking is like being given life again.
questions.explanation: It reminds us that each new day is a gift from Allah.

questions.question: What does 'wa ilayhin-nushur' mean?
questions.answer: And to Him is the resurrection.
questions.explanation: It connects daily waking to the Day of Judgment.

questions.question: Who reported that the Prophet ﷺ said this upon waking?
questions.answer: Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman (RA).
questions.explanation: It is recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari.

title: Alhamdu Lillahil-Ladhi Bini'matihi Tatimmus-Salihat – Gratitude for Good Blessings
arabicFull: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
transliterationFull: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi bini'matihi tatimmus-salihat
translationFull: All praise is for Allah by whose blessing good deeds are completed.
intro: A short supplication of gratitude recited when something good or pleasing occurs.
story: The Prophet ﷺ would praise Allah with these words whenever something pleasing happened. The supplication reminds believers that all good outcomes and successful deeds occur only through Allah’s blessings and assistance.
benefits: 🤲 Expresses gratitude for good outcomes
🌿 Reminds believers that success comes from Allah
✨ Encourages constant praise of Allah

phrases.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
phrases.meaning: All praise is for Allah by whose blessing good deeds are completed

questions.question: When did the Prophet ﷺ say this supplication?
questions.answer: Whenever something pleasing or good happened.
questions.explanation: It turns every good moment into gratitude.

questions.question: What does 'bini'matihi tatimmus-salihat' mean?
questions.answer: By whose blessing good deeds are completed.
questions.explanation: All success in good deeds comes from Allah.

questions.question: Why is it important to praise Allah when good happens?
questions.answer: So we remember that all good outcomes are from Allah's blessing.
questions.explanation: It prevents pride and strengthens thankfulness.

title: Alhamdu Lillahi 'Ala Kulli Hal – Gratitude in Every Situation
arabicFull: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ
transliterationFull: Alhamdu lillahi 'ala kulli hal
translationFull: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance.
intro: A short supplication expressing gratitude to Allah in every situation.
story: The Prophet ﷺ would say this phrase when something happened that was not pleasing. It teaches believers to maintain gratitude and trust in Allah regardless of circumstances, recognizing that every situation carries wisdom from Him.
benefits: 🤲 Encourages gratitude even during hardship
🌿 Strengthens patience and trust in Allah
✨ A simple remembrance that can be said anytime

phrases.meaning: All praise is for Allah in every circumstance

questions.question: When did the Prophet ﷺ say this phrase?
questions.answer: When something happened that was not pleasing.
questions.explanation: He taught gratitude even in difficulty.

questions.question: What does 'ala kulli hal' mean?
questions.answer: In every circumstance.
questions.explanation: We praise Allah in ease and in hardship.

questions.question: Why is this supplication powerful in hard times?
questions.answer: It maintains gratitude and trust in Allah when things are difficult.
questions.explanation: It strengthens patience and reliance on divine wisdom.

title: Ya Muqallibal Qulub – Steadfastness of the Heart
arabicFull: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
transliterationFull: Ya Muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik
translationFull: O Turner of the hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
intro: A powerful supplication asking Allah to keep the heart firm upon faith.
story: Anas ibn Malik (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ frequently recited this supplication. When asked why he said it so often, the Prophet ﷺ explained that the hearts of people are between two fingers of Allah, and He turns them as He wills. Therefore believers should constantly ask Allah to keep their hearts firm upon the truth.
benefits: ❤️ Seeks firmness of faith
🤲 Reminds believers that hearts are controlled by Allah
✨ Encourages constant reliance on Allah for guidance

phrases.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
phrases.meaning: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion

questions.question: What does 'Ya Muqallibal Qulub' mean?
questions.answer: O Turner of the hearts.
questions.explanation: Allah alone controls and turns hearts toward or away from faith.

questions.question: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about the hearts of people?
questions.answer: They are between two fingers of Allah, and He turns them as He wills.
questions.explanation: That is why we constantly ask Him to keep our hearts firm.

questions.question: Who reported that the Prophet ﷺ frequently recited this dua?
questions.answer: Anas ibn Malik (RA).
questions.explanation: It is recorded in Jamiʿ at-Tirmidhi.

outsideSalah: When asking Allah for steadfastness in faith
Anytime seeking guidance and firmness of belief

title: Allahumma Musarrifal Qulub – Turn Our Hearts to Your Obedience
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
transliterationFull: Allahumma musarrifal-qulub, sarrif qulubana 'ala ta'atik
translationFull: O Allah, Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts toward Your obedience.
intro: A supplication asking Allah to guide and direct our hearts toward obedience to Him.
story: Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-As (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ taught this supplication, reminding believers that hearts are under the control of Allah. The dua teaches humility and reliance upon Allah for guidance and steadfastness.
benefits: ❤️ Seeks guidance of the heart toward obedience
🤲 Reminds believers that hearts are controlled by Allah
✨ Encourages reliance on Allah for steadfastness

phrases.meaning: O Allah, Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts toward Your obedience

questions.question: What does 'Musarrifal Qulub' mean?
questions.answer: Controller (or Turner) of the hearts.
questions.explanation: Allah directs hearts toward or away from obedience.

questions.question: What do we ask Allah to direct our hearts toward?
questions.answer: His obedience (ta'ah).
questions.explanation: Steadfastness means the heart consistently turns to obedience.

title: Allahumma Ihdini Wa Saddidni – Guidance and Correctness
arabicFull: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
transliterationFull: Allahumma ihdini wa saddidni
translationFull: O Allah, guide me and make me steadfast and correct.
intro: A short supplication asking Allah for guidance and correctness in actions.
story: Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA) reported that the Prophet ﷺ instructed him to say this supplication. The Prophet ﷺ explained that asking for guidance means asking Allah to show the right path, and asking for correctness means asking Allah to keep one's actions straight and accurate.
benefits: 🧭 Seeks guidance to the right path
🤲 Asks Allah for correctness and steadfastness
✨ A simple prophetic supplication for daily guidance

phrases.meaning: O Allah, guide me and make me correct and steadfast

questions.question: What two things does this short dua ask for?
questions.answer: Guidance (hidayah) and correctness or steadfastness (tasdid).
questions.explanation: The Prophet ﷺ instructed Ali (RA) to say it for both.

questions.question: What did the Prophet ﷺ say 'saddidni' means?
questions.answer: To make one's actions straight and correct.
questions.explanation: It is a request for consistency and accuracy in deeds.

questions.question: Who did the Prophet ﷺ instruct to recite this supplication?
questions.answer: Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA).
questions.explanation: It is recorded in Sahih Muslim.
